page.heading: Make your own
page.subtitle: Templates you author are saved in this browser, ready to film in the studio.

empty.title: Your templates will live here.
empty.subtitle: Start from a blank canvas, or duplicate a sample below and make it yours.

contribute.title: Contribute a template
contribute.description: Built something great? Share it with the LeClap community on GitHub.

page.partialsHint: Reusable intro, outro and overlay blocks you can drop into any template.

partials.title: Partials
partials.subtitle: Build reusable scene fragments with the same visual controls as templates.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this template?
deleteDialog.description: “{{name}}” will be removed from this browser. There’s no undo.

convertDialog.title: Convert to partial?
convertDialog.description: "{{name}}" will be converted into a reusable partial scene. The original template is not deleted — you can still edit it from the list.

shareDialog.title: Contribute on GitHub
shareDialog.description: Share this template with the LeClap community in two steps.
shareDialog.step2: Open the repo on GitHub, create a new branch, paste the JSON as a new template file, then open a pull request.

editor.subtitle: Build your scenes top to bottom, then save — it appears in the builder as a Custom template.

wholeVideo.label: Whole-video animation files
wholeVideo.hint: Animation files played as-is over the entire video, across every section. Effects are added per scene.

wholeVideoLook.label: Whole-video look & grade
wholeVideoLook.hint: One colour treatment applied to the entire video, on top of each scene’s own look.

io.label: Import / export
io.hint: Export this template as JSON, or import a descriptor to replace the current one.

jsonEditor.label: Raw JSON
jsonEditor.hint: Edit the template descriptor directly, then Apply to validate and load your changes.
jsonEditor.stateChanged: The template changed elsewhere — your edits are still here.

variables.label: Global variables
variables.hint: Reusable values you can insert as #token in any text.
variables.empty: No variables yet — add one to reuse a value in any text.
variables.name: Variable {{index}} key

colorsList.label: Colour palette
colorsList.hint: Ordered swatches usable as #color1, #color2… in any colour field.

colorField.unresolved: Unknown variable — set its colour in the Variables tool
colorField.hint: Pick a variable to keep this colour in sync with it everywhere it's used

scenes.label: Scenes
scenes.hint: Each scene plays in order, top to bottom — drag the handle to rearrange.
scenes.empty: No scenes yet — add your first one below.

validation.name: Give your template a name.
validation.mediaOrUpload: Pick at least one option for the {{label}} section, or allow uploads.
validation.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted section errors before saving.

importError.title: Could not import
importError.description: The file is not a valid template descriptor.

shell.resizePanels: Drag to resize preview and panel
shell.partialReadonly: Built-in partials are read-only. Duplicate one to make it your own — your copy is saved in this browser.

partialDeleteDialog.title: Delete this partial?
partialDeleteDialog.description: “{{name}}” will be removed from this browser, and templates that use it won’t render until you replace it.

shell.timelineEmptyTitle: Build your story scene by scene

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: Press ? anytime to open this list

presets.pickerSubtitle: Pick a ready-made structure, or start from a blank canvas.

talking-head.name: Talking-head intro
talking-head.description: Title card, your clip, and an outro.

product-showcase.name: Product showcase
product-showcase.description: Ken Burns image, your clip, and background music.

testimonial.name: Testimonial
testimonial.description: A quote with a lower third, then a closing card.

monitor.fallbackMusicSubtitle: Sets the template's background music — it plays under the video with nothing on screen.
monitor.fallbackFormSubtitle: Viewers fill these fields before rendering; their answers feed the template variables.

testRender.ariaLabel: Render a preview of this template with sample footage
testRender.title: Preview render
testRender.description: A fast draft using sample footage — placeholder clips stand in for your video sections.

media.urlHint: Paste a direct link — fetched at compile time, not stored on device.
media.emptyLibrary: Nothing here yet — upload your own instead.
media.dropTrack: Drop a track or click to browse
media.dropImage: Drop an image or click to browse
media.dropVideo: Drop a video or click to browse
media.rejectInvalidType: {{name}} isn't a file we can use here — try {{formats}}
media.rejectTooLarge: {{name}} is too large to store on this device
media.rejectTooMany: {{name}} was skipped — this slot takes one file
media.rejectSaveFailed: Couldn't save {{name}} — this device's storage may be full

overlay.selectOrAdd: Select a text — or add one below.
overlay.boxPaddingHint: Breathing room around the text. Corners stay square — the renderer can't round them.
overlay.insertVariableHint: Add a form field or global variable first
overlay.label: Text {{index}}
overlay.empty: No text yet. Add one to start.
overlay.selectHint: Select a text on the preview, or pick one below.

audio.label: Audio
audio.hint: Balance your recorded clip against the music, then add finishing touches.
audio.normalizeHintOff: Loudness is left exactly as recorded.
audio.normalizeHintLoudnorm: Evens the whole video out to a broadcast-standard loudness.
audio.normalizeHintDynamic: Smooths volume swings in real time as the video plays.

framing.label: Framing guide
framing.hint: A silhouette shown while recording to help frame the shot — never rendered into the video.
framing.mirrorNote: Mirrored on the front camera, like a mirror.

layer.name: Layer {{index}}
layer.directionHint: The arrow points from the start colour toward the end colour.
layer.shapeHint: Radial fills from the centre, circular sweeps around it, spiral twists the sweep.
layer.borderHint: Stroke drawn along the layer's edge, over the fill.
layer.revealHintSolid: Solid layers appear at the delay (no fade) — use a gradient layer for a soft fade or slide.
layer.revealHintGradient: Gradient layers fade or slide in with the chosen entrance.

animation.label: Animation
animation.dropAnimation: Drop an animation file or click to browse
animation.animationFormats: APNG, WebM · kept inline in the template
animation.fitStretchHint: Fill the W×H box freely, may distort
animation.fitContainHint: Fit inside the box, keep the aspect ratio
animation.fitCoverHint: Fill the box and crop the overflow
animation.dragHint: Drag to move · corner to resize · arrows to nudge

interface-focus.name: Interface focus
interface-focus.description: Frame a detail with a brief pulse.

product-spotlight.name: Product spotlight
product-spotlight.description: A soft orbit and a single shine sweep.

celebration-burst.name: Celebration burst
celebration-burst.description: A short confetti and sparkle accent.

focus-lock.name: Focus lock
focus-lock.description: A bracket frame with one soft ring.

light-pass.name: Light pass
light-pass.description: A brief light wash and a small sparkle.

frame-reveal.name: Frame reveal
frame-reveal.description: A fine frame with a single shine sweep.

groups.samplesHint: Ready-made files that look the same in every template.

picker.addLabel: Add the {{label}} effect (drawn by the engine, adjustable)
picker.upgradeHint: A file played as-is. The {{label}} effect draws the same idea, tuned to this scene.

fx.previewHint: Previewed live on the canvas. The exact look renders in “Preview render”.
fx.notTunable: This graphic has no controls here yet. Edit it in the JSON editor.
fx.livePreview: Live preview · exact look in Preview render
fx.livePreviewStill: Still preview (reduced motion) · full effect in Preview render
fx.livePreviewNone: Nothing to draw on this target · see Preview render
fx.renderSceneHint: A quick draft of this scene only, with the exact effect.

effect.name: Effect
effect.title: Effects
effect.subtitle: Drawn by LeClap and tuned to this scene

file.name: Animation file
file.title: Animation files
file.subtitle: A clip played as-is on top of the scene

element.selectHint: Select an element to edit its settings
element.caption: Caption
element.detachHint: Turns this block into free text elements you can drag anywhere — its automatic layout is lost.
element.reorderHint: Elements layer by type. Reorder items of the same type with the arrows or by dragging.

shape.cornerRadiusHint: Rounds the rectangle's corners, in output pixels.
shape.strokeHint: An outline drawn just inside the shape's edge.

panel.hint: The generated rounded-rect backdrop behind this caption. Size follows the template's layout. Color must be a solid hex value — variables aren't supported here.

capture.hint: Which inputs the person filming can use — front or back camera, screen recording, or a file upload. Never rendered into the video.
capture.lockedNote: A single allowed source locks the recorder to it.

imageOverlay.label: Image
imageOverlay.windowHint: Seconds within the scene — 0 keeps that side open.

hint.form: Ask the viewer for text to overlay
hint.color: Solid color card with a title
hint.music: Background track for the whole video

timeline.label: Timeline
timeline.hint: Click a block to jump to its section. Drag, or focus and press Alt + ← / → to reorder.

transition.title: Transition
transition.description: How this section blends into the next one.
transition.label: {{name}} · {{duration}}s
transition.defaultHint: Used at every scene change that doesn't pick its own transition.
transition.defaultDescription: How scenes blend into each other when a boundary doesn't choose its own transition.

variables.none: No variables yet — add a form field or global variable to reference here

video.whatToFilmPlaceholder: e.g. Stand centered, look at the camera, say your name
video.whatToFilmHint: Shown to the person filming while they record — a quick prompt, never burned into the video.
video.speedHint: Slower or faster playback also stretches or shortens this scene in the final video.
video.sourceHint: Camera asks the person to film this scene; Video clip plays a fixed video you provide — a brand bumper or stock footage.

image.allowUpload: Allow viewers to upload their own image

fit.label: Frame fit
fit.hint: Fill crops the footage to fill the frame; Letterbox keeps it all visible with bars; Blur keeps it all visible over a blurred copy instead of bars; Off uses the file as-is, without fitting it to the frame.

musicSection.pickTracks: Pick the tracks viewers can choose from.
musicSection.allowUpload: Allow viewers to upload their own track

reveal.label: Entrance
reveal.easingHint: How motion settles — Ease out glides into place; overshoot briefly passes its resting position.

exit.label: Exit
exit.afterHint: Leave untouched and the exit finishes with the scene; drag to start it at a fixed time.

accent.label: Accent
accent.hint: Draws a small underline bar in the accent colour beneath the text.
accent.hintTitleCard: Draws the underline bar and tints the kicker.
accent.hintLowerThird: Colours the band’s accent bar and the badge.

chromaKey.hint: Key out a solid screen colour (green/blue screen) and composite the clip over a flat colour.

titleCard.headline: Headline
titleCard.subtitle: Subtitle
titleCard.hint: A clean kicker / headline / subtitle card — sized to the orientation.

lowerThird.title: Title
lowerThird.subtitle: Subtitle
lowerThird.hint: A title / subtitle band over the clip, with an optional badge.

watermark.label: Watermark
watermark.hint: A logo image composited in one corner of every scene, authored once.

globalOverlay.label: Whole-video text
globalOverlay.hint: Text drawn on every section — e.g. a brand watermark, authored once.
globalOverlay.opacityRevealNote: The entrance animation drives the opacity while a reveal is set.
globalOverlay.sectionsHint: Leave all off to draw the text on every scene.

caption.label: Caption
caption.hint: A styled text band burned onto this scene.

scene.notesHint: Private notes for collaborators — never shown in the video.
scene.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Swap this clip after the launch…

styleReference.label: Match a reference
styleReference.hint: Upload an image, and optionally a short clip. Its palette, texture and pacing become a theme; subjects, logos and text are never copied.
styleReference.error: This reference could not be analysed: {{message}}

level.aaLarge: passes AA for large text only

styleReference.applied: Theme applied to global.theme. Undo reverts it.

link.opening: Opening the template from your link…
link.privacy: The template travelled inside the link itself: nothing was uploaded.
link.rebindTitle: Some media stayed on the other computer
link.rebindBody: The link carries the template, not its files. Film, upload or pick these again:
link.errorTitle: This link could not be opened
link.errorHint: Ask for a fresh link, or export the template as JSON and use Import in the Advanced panel.

errors.unsupported_version: The link was made by a newer version of LeClap.
errors.malformed: The link is incomplete. It was probably cut off when it was copied.
errors.too_large: The template is too large to travel in a link.
errors.corrupt: The link is damaged. It was probably cut off when it was copied.
errors.invalid_json: The link does not contain a template.
errors.invalid_template: The template in the link is not valid.
errors.invalid_base_url: The link points at an invalid address.

link.replaceBody: It opens as a new draft in place of this one. Save this draft first if you want to keep it.

pinnedCaptions.label: Captions
pinnedCaptions.hint: Words transcribed from the clip (on the phone or with leclap transcribe). Fix a misheard word in place; amber words are the ones the recogniser was unsure of. Timings stay as transcribed.
